seo.title: Operating Room | Vēna Vitals
seo.description: Continuous, noninvasive arterial blood pressure monitoring for operating room and anesthesiology workflows.

title: Every beat of every case.
intro: Continuous, noninvasive arterial blood pressure through the whole case, without an arterial line.

cards.title: A-line delay
cards.body: An arterial line can take time to place, and not every case has that time.

cards.title: A-line risk
cards.body: Arterial lines are invasive and carry procedure risk, so they are not placed in every case.

cards.title: Cuff blind spots
cards.body: A cuff reads every few minutes, leaving gaps where pressure swings go unseen.

fitTitle: Apply in pre-op, out of the surgical field
fitBody: The soft wrap fits around the foot, seating the sensor over the dorsalis pedis artery and away from the surgical field. The sensor streams beat-to-beat arterial pressure to the bedside iPad from induction through emergence, and the wrap comes off cleanly at the end of the case.
windowsBody: From placement on the foot to a continuous trace at the bedside, without occupying the arm or sterile field.

windows.label: Applied to the foot, out of the field

noteTitle: Studied in more than 600 surgical patients against arterial lines.
noteBody: VeriTrack validation material compares continuous waveform and blood pressure readings with the arterial-line reference standard.
cta: See it in your operating room
